claims.claim: GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportHandler paginates with skip(cursor) on top of sort(sort) and computes nextCursor as cursor + limit, i.e. offset-based pagination without a stable tie-breaker key.
reserveBalance converts balances and the transfer value with Number() via toNumber and computes the balance after as before - amount or before + amount using JavaScript double arithmetic.
When statusAfter is given, buildFilter filters the requested status list down to only SUCCESS, so a request with status=FAILED plus statusAfter yields status: {$in: []} and returns no rows.
buildFilter applies dateTo as createdAt $lte new Date(params.dateTo) without extending to end of day, matching the existing trans-his exports in this repo.

QueryHandlerFactory registers GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportQuery to the Mongo handler unconditionally, before and independent of the getTransHisExportSource() === 'postgres' switch used by GetAllTransHisExportQuery.

safeText prefixes a single quote to any cell text starting with =, +, -, @, tab or CR, and transformRow wraps every free-text column (customerId, partnerUserId, phone, fullName, merchantCode, email, name, note) with safeText.
The export adapter declares TransHisModel and MerchantModel as the required models via getRequiredModelName().
buildSort accepts the strings 'ASC' and 'ascend' as ascending sort directions.
The merchant lookup failure in GetAllPartnerUserReserveExportHandler rethrows the error so the whole export job fails.
